text:
Maria (Product): ok team — quick sync on post-launch iteration for the stabilize track. We shipped last week; feedback & errors coming in. Need a short decision: which items are hotfixes (urgent patch, fast rollback path) vs enhancements (next minor). I sketched criteria below, please react and own.

Criteria proposal: 
• Severity P0/P1 (data loss, auth, payment) => hotfix
• High-traffic regressions with >5% user error rate => hotfix
• Single-customer but high-revenue => escalate, usually hotfix
• Anything UX polish / feature gaps / perf <15% regressions => enhancement queue

Also: propose a cadence — two-week mini-sprint for enhancements; hotfixes release ASAP with canary + rollback plan. Need owners for: bug triage, hotfix PR, canary monitoring, and customer comms.

Kevin (Eng): +1 on criteria. Two notes: 
1) We should add "fix risk" — if a fix touches model-serving runtime or database migrations, prefer staged rollouts and treat as enhancement unless P0.
2) Capacity: we have 4 dev-days free in week 1, ~8 in week 2. That shapes what we can patch immediately.

Daniel (QA): current numbers from smoke runs: 18 issues flagged, 5 failing regression tests, 3 reproducible crashes (user session loss). Short summary: 
- crash A: session serialization NPE, repro steps in ticket 4821
- crash B: websocket reconnect loop under load (logs below)

```
ERROR conn.go:142 reconnect: panic: nil pointer
stack: runtime.go:200
```

I can own triage for the crashes and run a quick bisect. Prefer we treat session NPE as P1 hotfix.

Anya (Design): UX cluster: search suggestion order is off for some long-tail queries (reported by two customers). This isn't blocking but looks bad. We can ship a quick ranking tweak as a short enhancement (1 day), or redesign the ranking pipeline (multi-week). Recommend quick tweak now and include in mini-sprint.

Lina (Customer Success): heard from 2 paying customers complaining about session drops (one enterprise on Dedicated). They've requested a timeline; if we don't respond in 48h they'll escalate. Recommend hotfix for session NPE and immediate customer comms. I can draft messages.

Sam (SRE): for any hotfix we need: canary on 5% traffic in region-us, + realtime error-rate alert, and a kill-switch to revert routing to previous model variant. Also note: DB migration blocker — we cannot do schema changes until we freeze backups (window Thu 02:00-04:00 UTC). If fix involves DB schema, it's not ASAP.

deploy-bot: deploy scheduled: stabilize-hotfix-candidate -> staging at 1716801400, will promote after smoke checks.

Kevin (Eng): I'll pick up session NPE PR if Daniel provides repro and suggested test. Can do patch + unit test today. If risk low we can target canary tonight.

Maria (Product): decisions so far: 
- Session NPE (crash A) => P1 hotfix. Owner: Kevin (PR) + Daniel (triage/tests) + Sam (canary/monitoring) + Lina (customer comms).
- Websocket reconnect loop => treat as P1 investigative hotfix; Daniel to triage, Kevin to estimate.
- Search suggestion ranking => enhancement; include in next 2-week mini-sprint (Anya lead, estimated 1 day dev).
- Other low-impact regressions => backlog grooming, assign to next minor.

Next steps: 
1) Daniel posts repro + failing test link here (ticket 4821).
2) Kevin opens branch stabilize/session-npe and tags @sam deploy when ready.
3) Lina drafts customer note and sends to me for sign-off within 24h.
4) Follow-up standup in #product tomorrow 10:30am PT to confirm canary health.

Anyone disagree or want different owners? :slightly_smiling_face:

Lina (Customer Success): ok, will draft now and paste here for sign-off.

Daniel (QA): repro + failing test link: https://go/redwood/tickets/4821 — added logs and a minimal test. I also attached a short playback script.

Kevin (Eng): branch created: https://go/redwood/merge/8245 — small null-check + unit. requesting review @daniel. If CI green, please queue canary.

Sam (SRE): will add canary job and alerting rule. Note: add metric `session_reconnect_failure_rate` to the dashboard. I'll post dash link once up.

Maria (Product): awesome. I'll send the customer note draft in 30m and schedule the 10:30am check. Thanks all — quick wins first, keep enhancements scoped to the mini-sprint. :rocket:
